text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
More! More and more! I must hone this 'Holy Sword'
far beyond what it is right now!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Just touching the blade is enough
to cleave both white silver and black steel in two!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Even if Right O-san doesn't
take the lead at top speed. And...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Even if Believe-san doesn't
keep up a high pace...)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"This 'Holy Sword' must shine brightly
at all times, without exception!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"To do that, no matter what trials and tribulations await,
I must overcome them—!"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: By your command, Lord Trainer!

Repeating 3-furlong—600-meter—dashes over and over again.
While that blade is honed at an astonishing speed...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Kh... Is this as far as I go...?
I have no energy left...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Not one more step... My King... Forgive...
choice_data_list: It's amazing that you can run this far!
It's amazing that you can run this far!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Huh... I-Is that so...?
I'm honored by your praise, um...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! My energy has returned!
I can still keep going, if the King so desires!

Even when on the verge of exhaustion, one rises with high morale.
Thus, the "Holy Sword" was honed to its absolute limit.

"And then, the day of the Takamatsunomiya Kinen.
Chukyo Racecourse, a 1200m GⅠ race, but..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Today... our adaptability will be put to the test.
It's a course we rarely get to run on.
choice_data_list: Yeah, a GⅠ held at a local venue is pretty rare.
Yeah, a G1 held at a local track is pretty rare, you know.

text_block_list.text:
Normally, GⅠ races are held at racecourses
such as Tokyo, Nakayama, Hanshin, and Kyoto.

"Still, this Takamatsunomiya Kinen is being held at Chukyo.
On top of being quite rare..."

The distance is a bit concerning, too. It's 1,200 meters,
not 1,600. It's a distance that favors front-runners,
making it notoriously tough for late closers...
"If she can run well under these conditions, it will be undeniable proof that she can draw the 'Holy Sword' at any time."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Now then—I shall go test my blade.
My King, please bear witness.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: A swift slash straight from the draw. To see just how much my 'Holy Sword' has evolved.
choice_data_list: Yeah, show me what you've got!
Yeah, let's see what you've got!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(If I can break through here, next is the Yasuda Kinen.
So many rivals will gather there.)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(It's like... the grand spring martial arts tournament.
Before heading there, I must finish
the 'Holy Sword' no matter what.)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
A 1,200m blitz. Even if the other Umamusume
run like purple lightning—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
My strike is swifter still!
I shall slice through lightning itself!
